annotations.title: Set webhook inbox pro forwarding, signature checks and handshakes

description: Set your webhook inbox pro plan: inbox_instance_id (the inbox to upgrade, same address), forward ({url} or null), verify ({preset: github|stripe|slack|zoom|hmac, secret, ...} or null), handshakes ({slack, zoom, meta_verify_token}). Fields left out stay. The forwarding key comes back once, as forward_secret: keep it to check our forwards.

forward.description: Where to forward every message; null turns it off.

handshakes.description: Answer the Slack, Zoom or Meta URL checks.

inbox_instance_id.description: The inbox to upgrade (one of yours).

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.

rotate_forward_secret.description: true: a new forwarding key (returned once).

forward_only_verified.description: true: forward only messages whose signature verified; the rest stay in the inbox (forward status skipped, not_verified).

secret.description: The sender's signing secret (stored encrypted, never shown).

verify.description: Sender signature check; null turns it off.

name: inbox_pro_set
title: Set webhook inbox pro forwarding, signature checks and handshakes
